text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black realized that more than a 
lack of skill, she lacked "star power." 
Even before her debut, Satono Diamond was 
already commanding the reporters' 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her rival "Brusqueman" 
possessed dazzling glamour, and even had a 
kindred spirit in Air Groove who truly 
understood her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black loses her confidence. Just 
then, Sakura Bakushin O makes her 
entrance, having felt an entirely 
one-sided sense of sympathy for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Buoyed by that momentum, they set their 
sights on the Satsuki Sho and Japanese 
Derby while heading toward their next 
objective together: the St. Lite Kinen.
